comment: The quiet record the throughput board reads. One entry per window in which pull requests were HELD from merging (kind merge-quiet, one repository) or the CI pool itself was stalled (kind ci-pool-stall, every repository). A pull request whose life (opened_at to merged_at) overlaps a window for its repository is labelled with that window in the derived column pr.disruption; every other pull request is labelled clean. apply-disruption-columns.sh converges the derived columns and the board's confound panel from this file. Add a window when its QUIET OFF is posted: id, kind, repos (or ["*"]), start and end in UTC, and the ledger source.
note: INTERIM: until livespec-dev-tooling-35iexd ships (QUIET OFF appends its own window here in the same act), throughput-plans-coordinator appends each window by pull request at every QUIET OFF it receives (ruling 2026-11-15).

start_rule_change.text: M2 lead time's start moved on 2026-11-14: the first commit's author time for a seat PR, or the factory run marker for a factory PR. Events emitted before carry no pr.start_rule and are labelled old start rule in pr.lead_rule. The lead-time band was built under the old rule and is rebuilt about 2026-11-21; until then old and new lead times are not comparable.
